purpose: Test whether the v1 answer flips depend on the donor signal and its indexed placement, rather than arbitrary perturbation size
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.

controls.random_word_rows: Five Gaussian matrices with seeds 101..105, scaled to the word-row donor-minus-recipient Frobenius norm and inserted at the word rows
controls.donor_delta_wrong_chunk: The exact donor-minus-recipient word-row difference is added at equal-count rows in a different attention chunk
controls.shuffled_word_rows: The donor-minus-recipient word-row difference is permuted across word rows with seed 201 before insertion at the word rows

primary_endpoint: complete answer equals donor color and normal EOS
interpretation_limit: The v2 controls were selected after seeing v1 flips, so they strengthen or weaken v1 interpretation but are not preregistered before the v1 observation.
